regions.label: Minimal header with w2m chip logo and serif wordmark
Mono eyebrow, mixed-type H1 Word to Markdown, subtitle, .docx to .md file-chip diagram, Converting docs since 2014
Converted result: title Converted pasted.md, Copy/Download/Convert another buttons, side-by-side Markdown source and rendered Preview panels (fixed-height scroll panes)
Post-conversion bordered callout promoting the maker's book with See Open & Async link
Language switcher row (20+ locales), site links row, mono tagline

evidence.note: Post-handoff state: the pasted document arrived and was converted; Convert another file resets to the entry point (dropzone copy 'Drop your .docx here or click to choose a file' appears in the converted text)
Two equal fixed panes side by side: raw Markdown source and rendered Preview of the same document, each scrolling independently at ~400px tall in the real viewport; no resize divider

patterns.rationale: Panes are not resizable, which the definition requires; it is a fixed two-column source/preview layout.

evidence.quote: Nice — one more doc out of Word and into the open. I wrote the playbook for working this way:
evidence.note: Bordered inline callout shown after conversion with one link action

patterns.rationale: Callout is promotional rather than a condition needing attention; could be read as a plain promo block.

evidence.note: Markdown pane is read-only monospace output, no syntax colouring or editing tools
'Conversion complete' is a screen-reader status region, not a visible toast
Only a small reference table inside the rendered preview of converted content

structure.layout: single centred column tool page: slim header, centred hero, converter workspace with action row and two side-by-side scrolling panes, callout, centred multilingual footer

aesthetics.typography: Fraunces (serif, italic for 'Word' in H1, wordmark, H2s); JetBrains Mono for 'Markdown' in H1, eyebrow, file chips, code pane, footer tagline; Hanken Grotesk for body, buttons, links
aesthetics.typeScale: High contrast: 72px H1 mixing italic serif and mono, 20px subtitle, 18px serif H2, 14px buttons/body, 10-13px letter-spaced mono eyebrows and pane labels

notes: Warm off-white page with a faint dot-grid texture in the upper area; chartreuse #d0d820 used sparingly for the primary Copy Markdown button, logo chip and .md chip, with olive #646a00 for eyebrow and accent text. The H1 deliberately mixes an italic Fraunces 'Word', grey sans 'to' and mono 'Markdown' to embody the conversion. Capture is in converted state (pasted the site itself), so both panes contain the page's own content; real panes are ~400px tall scroll boxes. Pane headers use small coloured dot + mono uppercase label. Footer offers ~20 locales in a centred wrap row.
